text:
audrey: quick q — we need to change RBAC so oncall can do JIT operator-delegation for HSM imports (customer-managed keys). compliance (PCI / SOC2) expects split-ops + immutable audit trail. can we do this without widening long-lived entitlements? :thinking_face:
corey: short answer: yes, but design matters. are we talking temporary wrap/unwrapped key operations or witness-only flows?
maya: prefer witness-only where possible. if we must allow wrap/unwrapped, do it via a time-bound 'operator session' that mints a short-lived proxy token. require MFA and justification. log everything.
raj: retention: PCI has a bunch of nuanced retention bits. we're currently shipping HSM/audit logs to kinesis with 90d retention — that's a compliance gap if customer asks for 1y. need legal confirmation, but we should prepare for 1y cold archive.
audrey: is 1y mandatory or can we encrypt and store offsite? asking for tradeoffs.
zach: legal/PCI folks usually want evidence of controls for 12 months for some key lifecycle events. SOC2 less prescriptive (90d often fine). escalate to legal but plan engineering change anyway.
corey: vuln note: there's an advisory about hsm-sidecar (CVE-2026-0423) — local privilege escalation in older sidecars. patch available. we should include that in the plan.
maya: patch 1.2.4 fixes it. deployment caveat: patch forces sidecar restart + rehandshake with HSM; that will interrupt ongoing imports if done naively. schedule canary first.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: hsm-sidecar 1.2.3 -> 1.2.4 canary in staging at 2026-03-22T02:00Z.
audrey: RBAC model proposal (sketch): create role 'hsm_jit_operator' scoped to customer account + operation type. Session tokens max 1h, require 2FA + attestation token, and require an active justification string stored in audit. All actions emit: request_id, operator_id, session_id, operation_type, customer_key_fingerprint.
raj: also add automatic post-op verification: rewrap check and a reconsiliation job that verifies wrap_consistency. add a revoke-list so we can immediately invalidate sessions.
corey: KMS integration Q: for external customer KMS or HSM, how do we record provenance without storing secrets?
maya: store metadata only: key_fingerprint, attestation_blob (signed), kms_policy_snapshot, and a TTLed proof bundle that is encrypted with our CMK. never store key material plaintext. that gives traceability without custody.
audrey: good. note: compliance may want signed attestation from the HSM vendor. plan to include vendor attestation blob in the audit record.
zach: IR/runbook: add step to freeze delegation and trigger immediate rewrap if suspicious activity detected. oncall should escalate to security@redwood and legal, and preserve the attestation bundle and audit stream for forensics.
raj: we should also update oncall playbooks to include the exact kinesis stream names and retention paths — makes evidence collection faster.
audrey: propose a tabletop + weekend drill: tabletop Tue 2026-03-24 15:00, drill Sat 2026-03-28 09:00. anyone object?
zach: fine from infra.
corey: ok from platform side. will draft RBAC PR.
maya: i'll open retention ticket to increase archive to 1y and add cold-store encryption steps.
elaine: i'll coordinate with legal/compliance and verify PCI items; will flag which events require 12mo retention.
audrey: action items recap: 1) RBAC PR (corey) 2) retention/archive ticket (maya) 3) patch coord + canary (zach) 4) legal/compliance check (elaine) 5) update oncall/runbooks + drill (raj/audrey). I'll open RFC and assign tasks. thanks everyone :pray:
